nodes.label: Alembic async migration config
nodes.rationale: Uses async_engine_from_config with NullPool - deliberate choice to avoid connection pooling during migrations to prevent stale connections.

nodes.label: Documentation navigation structure
nodes.rationale: Five doc groups: Getting Started, Guides, Reference, Troubleshooting, Releases. Reference group includes architecture/stack/api pages.

nodes.label: Next.js standalone output config
nodes.rationale: output: 'standalone' chosen for containerized deployment - bundles only required dependencies for minimal Docker image.

nodes.label: assess() migration request function
nodes.rationale: Falls back to mock MigrationPlan data on API error - supports offline/demo mode during development before backend is stable.

nodes.label: MigrationPlan type stub
nodes.rationale: Typed as `any` intentionally - permissive stub until domain shape is locked in; to be tightened as app stabilizes.

nodes.label: shadcn/ui component pattern
nodes.rationale: All UI components are custom shadcn-style implementations using cva + cn + React.forwardRef, NOT importing from @radix-ui - custom re-implementation without Radix dependency.

nodes.label: MigrationPlan domain concept
nodes.rationale: Core domain entity with fields: id, source, target, complexity_score, estimated_downtime_hours, risk_items[], cost_estimate, created_at.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS design tokens via CSS vars
nodes.rationale: All colors defined as HSL CSS variables (e.g. hsl(var(--primary))) - enables runtime theming without rebuilding CSS.
